Subject: Post-call recap + decision-sponsor intro request

Thanks again for taking the demo this afternoon — quick recap and proposed next steps from our side.

Key outcomes from today's call:
- Use case: triage and summarization for provider notes across three pilot clinics (ETL and short-context prompts).
- Primary success metric: 30% reduction in manual summarization time; security/PHI constraints are blocking factors.
- Timeline: pilot start targeted mid-March, pilot budget allocated to a Q1 PO but final approval sits with finance.

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Please introduce the decision sponsor (finance/CFO or budget owner) so we can align on procurement timeline and expected PO cadence.
2) Share any outstanding security questionnaire items we should prioritize — we can loop in our security lead.
3) I attached a mutual action plan (Polaris_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.xlsx) that outlines milestones; please review and flag any changes.

Attachments: Polaris_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.xlsx

Proposed short timeline:
- Introduce sponsor by 2/18
- Security Q&A + DPA draft by 2/23
- Contract + PO by end of March (if sponsor approves)

If it helps I can draft a 1-paragraph pitch for the sponsor that calls out ROI and minimal infra lift. Happy to join the intro.

Best,

Hi Samantha (and Rajiv) — thanks for the quick confirmation. Rajiv — nice to e-meet you. I promised a 1-slide ballpark for the pilot; high level below and attached as a PDF (Redwood_pricing_tiers.pdf).

Ballpark for 3-clinic pilot (est. 150k tokens/month):
- Hosted (lowest time-to-value): ~$6,500/month (includes streaming generation, light reranking)
- Dedicated small pool (if you want reserved capacity & lower latency): ~$12,000/month (includes reserved GPU hours, priority routing)
- One-time onboarding & integration (ETL + prompt engineering): $14,000 (fixed)

Typical line items we see in these pilots: token consumption, model tier, KV cache retention policy (auditable), and data retention controls. We can tighten numbers after we see exact token mix and SLAs.

I've also attached a draft DPA and a link to our SOC 2 report snapshot for Tom/legal. If it helps, Laura (cc) will coordinate a short security deep-dive with Katrina.

Attachments: Redwood_pricing_tiers.pdf, DPA_Draft.pdf

Proposed next step: brief 20-minute intro with Rajiv + Tom + Samantha + our finance lead to align approval points. Suggested times (PST):
- Fri 2/19 10:00 or 14:00
- Mon 2/22 09:30 or 15:00

If none of those work I can share a calendar poll.

Best,
